scope: Adversarial downgrade, replay, stripping and parser ambiguity testing across the Wave E transaction and wallet shadow paths.
transaction_attack_matrix: swap Ed25519 public keys across otherwise-valid hybrid transactions
swap ML-DSA public keys within the same parameter set
swap Ed25519 signatures across distinct payloads
swap ML-DSA signatures across distinct payloads
cross-parameter ML-DSA signature or public-key substitution
replay active Transaction v2 signature into hybrid Ed25519 component
replay hybrid Ed25519 signature into active Transaction v2
malformed base64 public keys and signatures
duplicate or contradictory legacy/hybrid field sets
polyglot object containing a complete valid Transaction v2 view and complete valid hybrid view
parser differential corpus: every case must have an unambiguous single verdict boundary
wallet_attack_matrix: legacy-only wallet metadata presented as PQ-upgraded
PQ-upgraded public metadata forced through the legacy recovery path
public-metadata downgrade with PQ fields stripped
anti_post_hoc_rules: attack cases are frozen before execution
no case may be deleted because it exposes an ambiguity
a real ambiguity is a PQ-07 finding and must be fixed or remain blocking
failed runs remain in the PQ-07 failure ledger
selective retry cannot erase a failure
active FAE files remain outside PQ-07 write authority
gate: Every unauthorized downgrade, replay, stripping, partial-object and parser-ambiguity attempt fails deterministically. No single object may be accepted simultaneously as active Transaction v2 and PQ hybrid shadow.
